name: The University of Sydney
description: The University of Sydney is a public research university founded in 1850, the oldest university in Australia. It is a member of the Group of Eight and teaches across medicine and health, law, engineering, business, science and the arts.
whyIncluded: Among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents, a Singapore parents' website), and a Group of Eight university on both the Singapore Medical Council and the Singapore Institute of Legal Education (SILE) recognition lists.

livingCosts.summary: The University of Sydney's own monthly estimate of accommodation, food, transport and personal costs for 12 months, using the middle of its ranges.
livingCosts.notes: University of Sydney 'General living costs' table (monthly AUD, figures from the Study Australia cost-of-living calculator; the page gives no year, 2026 is the year it was read), range midpoints. Housing: accommodation $980-$3,500. Food: food and groceries $1,000-$2,500. Transport: $130-$800. Personal: mobile phone $30-$100 + lifestyle $350-$650 + gym $70-$100. The page also cites the older Home Affairs visa minimum of $24,505/yr.

programmes.name: Master of Professional Engineering (Civil Engineering)
programmes.summary: Year 1 tuition for international students, plus the A$373 student services fee. Fees rise each year (A$60,800 in 2027), so later years cost more.
programmes.notes: 2026 indicative international full fee paying rate for Year 1 (48 credit points, 1.0 EFTSL) from the course page's fee data (sydney.edu.au/courses/courses/pc/master-of-professional-engineering-civil-engineering.html loads it from this JSON; course 077470M, 144 credit points over 3 years). All MPE specialisations (aerospace, biomedical, chemical, electrical, mechanical, software) carry the same rate, as does the 2-year 96-credit-point MPE (Accelerated) for engineering graduates (course 098247M). The same data lists 2027 at A$60,800. Compulsory = 2026 SSAF A$186.50/semester full-time x 2 (2027: A$193.00 x 2). Fees increase each year. No 2024/2025 fee history: the course page's fee data lists only 2026 and 2027, and earlier years' admission guides are no longer online. No 2024/2025 rows (checked 2026-10-06): Sydney's International Admission Guide covers undergraduate courses only (2025 edition, Wayback 2025-07-19), and the postgraduate course pages load fees from a coredata.json that neither Wayback nor Common Crawl captured (archived 2024/2025 HTML has no fee figures). The international-fees and fee-paying student pages (Common Crawl 2023-2025) link to no fee schedule. No 2024 or 2025 postgraduate international fee source was found. The SSAF for these years is known (2024 A$175.50 and 2025 A$182.50 per semester full-time, sydney.edu.au/students/ssaf.html), but there is no tuition figure to pair with it. No 2024/2025 rows (final sweep 2026-10-06). New sources tried: (1) the undated 2024 International Admission Guide (Wayback 20240224135547) and the 2024 and 2025 International Guides (usyd-international-guide.pdf, Wayback 20230807044829 and 20240730171520) list undergraduate courses only, plus the MD and DVM parts of double degrees. Both say postgraduate coursework fees are on the website. (2) A Wayback CDX scan of sydney.edu.au/content/dam/ for fee, tuition, postgraduate and guide PDFs from 2023 on found no postgraduate coursework fee schedule or faculty PG guide for 2024/2025. Business, Engineering and Law PG guides stop at 2018-2020; the MD international admissions guide 2026 only links to the course page. (3) The year-labelled agent source used for the JD and MD (OzTREKK) does not list this course. Aggregators (Shiksha, Collegedunia, TopUniversities, Mastersportal) give undated figures, so they were not used.
